name: Globe zoom
oneLiner: a real NASA Earth under a glass shell turns in the dark, lit by a low sun with city lights on the night side, then the camera dives in log space through the glass to one city where a glossy accent pin drops and sticks, rings run out over the lights and a glass label card lands with the place, a short label and its coordinates
say: when the speaker names a place ('I moved to Lisbon', 'our first customer was in Tokyo', 'it all started in a flat in London'): cut in as the sentence starts, the pin lands on the city's name. Set place, lat and lon to the real city; depth 2 to 2.5 for a country, 3.5 to 4.5 for a city
